Hidden Treasure Chests

This guide gives the required player action and the chest contents for all 78 quests.

Rule: If more than one condition succeeds, the game creates only the highest chest tier.

Chest maps: A filled red area is the exact trigger area. A pale ring, line, or number helps you find the area.

Sol maps: The quest can select one or more marks for each run. Stand at the center of a ring and use Force. The small inner ring shows the exact check area. The large outer ring helps you find the location.

MultiplayerNo player can die or continue. In each of the first three quest sections, at least one player must take no damage. In the last section, at least one player must not recover HP. Finish the final timed battle before its timer expires.
